data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Subahah" symbolizes the concept of the renewal and transformation that comes with each new day. It reminds us of the second chance to make things right, to be better, kinder, and more compassionate. In essence, it calls us to embrace the opportunities of a new day and to seek the guidance and blessings of God in all our endeavors.
